3.2 Data Source

  • Single cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq)
  • Original paper: Jin et al, 2025
  • Deposited in Neuroscience Multi-omic Data Archive (NeMO)
  • Download url: https://data.nemoarchive.org/other/grant/Mouse_Aging/zeng/transcriptome/scell/10x_v3/mouse/processed/counts/Mouse_Aging_10Xv3_normalized_20241115.h5ad.tar
  • Note: Only Hippocampal formation (HPF) data were subjected to this analysis

Jin et al (2025) sequenced brain sample collected from 44 aged mice (20 female, 24 male) and 64 young adult mice (31 female, 33 male) using Illumina NovaSeq6000 sequencing system (Modi et al, 2021) and 10X Genomics CellRanger pipline (v.6.0.0) to assemble sequenced reads to mm10/gencode.vM23 reference genome (Frankish et al, 2019). The raw sequence data contain 2,777,165 cells categorized in 6 major regions, 16 broad regions.

The 6 major regions were:

  1. Isocortex
  2. Hippocampal formation (HPF)
  3. Hypothalamus (HY)
  4. Cerebral nulcei (CNU)
  5. Midbrain
  6. Hindbrain

3.3 Packages Usage

Seurat (Hao et al, 2023) was utilized as basic frame work, to take advantage of it mature pipeline.

The following table categorized R packages utilization by biological analysis, data visualization, and pipeline utilities within this project based on their primary functionality.

Category Package Version Description Reference
Analytical Seurat 5.4.0 Basic framework for data management, Differential Gene Expression (DEG) analysis, and Umap visualization Hao et al, 2023
Analytical scrattch.bigcat 0.0.1 Initially selected for clustering, the same package utlized by Jin et al, 2025. Note: Utilization was unsuccessful due to limited documentation and local compatibility issues. Unpublished; github
Analytical scrattch.hicat 1.0.0 Alternative clustering package utilized; selected for superior documentation. Unpublished; github
Analytical Presto 1.0.0 Fast implimentation of Wilcoxon Rank Sum test Nathan & Raychaudhuri, 2019
Visualization ggplot2 4.0.1 Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA); visualization of cell subclass, ROI, sex, age, and doublet scores. Wickham, 2016
Visualization patchwork 1.3.2 Plots Composer Pedersen, 2025
Utilities annadataR [To be find on lab machine] Data loading; converting Python-native .h5ad formats into R-compatible Seurat objects. Deconinck et al, 2026
Utilities bookdown 0.46 HTML report formatting and generation. Xie, 2016
Utilities knitr 1.51 R Markdown environment configuration and dynamic table rendering. Xie, 2014
Utilities Matrix 1.7-3 Sparse and Dense Matrix data manipulation Bates et al, 2025
Utilities devtools 2.4.6 Grant developer mode for R packages, tunning scrattch.bigcat and scrattch.hicat Wickham et al, 2025

3.4 Normalization and quality control

The normalization and quality control step were conducted by Jin et al (2025). The raw counts were log-transformed and z-score normalized. Cells which number of gene detected < 1000 OR QC score < 50 OR Doublet score > 0.3 were removed.

3.5 Data loading and sub-setting

Figure x: Schematic of dissected brain regions; The red box indicate subsetted regions. (Modified from Jin et al, 2025; Figure 1 )
Figure x: Schematic of hierarchical “Cell type” annotation; The red box indicate subsetted classes. (Modified from Jin et al, 2025; Figure 1 )

The downloaded data is in .h5ad, popular single-cell transctiptome format in python ecosystem. annadataR was utilized to read .h5ad file into R and converted to seurat object, basic functional unit in Seurat pipeline. Then subset the whole HPF dataset by neuro/glia, age, sex, sub-region (roi) to the following subsets for the sake of data management.

  1. SeuratObj (Whole HPF)
  2. subset_obj (Random 3k subset of SeuratObj)
  3. neuro_seuratobj (Neuron)
  4. Non_neuro_seuratobj (Glia)
  5. zero_doublet_seuratobj (Cells with zero doublet score)
  6. male_seuratobj (male)
  7. female_seuratobj (female)
  8. adult_seuratobj (adult)
  9. aged_seuratobj (aged)
  10. ENT_seuratobj (Entorhinal cortex)
  11. HIP_seuratobj (Hippocampus)
  12. HIP_CA_seuratobj (Hippocampus, Cornu Ammonis)
  13. PAR_POST_PRE_SUB_ProS_seuratobj (Hippocampal-subicular)

3.6 Exploratory Data Analysis

ggplot2 was utilized for visualization. Cell sub_class, roi, sex, age, and Doublet_score, one of the quality control score utilized by Jin et al (2025), proposed by McGinnis (2019), were plotted and examined.

5 Discussion

Jin et al (2025) conducted clustering using unpublished, in-house developed R package scrattch.bigcat (v.0.0.1) (https://github.com/AllenInstitute/scrattch.bigcat), which is a sub-package of scrattch package (https://alleninstitute.github.io/scrattch/) optimized for extremely large single cell dataset by support parallel computing and in-disk data access. However, because scrattch.bigcat (v.0.0.1) wasn’t formally released, it was poorly documented and failed to function on local lab machine after weeks’ attempt to rescue. Thus, an alternative sub-package of scrattch, scrattch.hicat (https://github.com/AllenInstitute/scrattch.hicat), was utilized. scrattch.hicat doesn’t support parallel computing and in-disk data access, but provide better documentation.
